result.reason: The added operative language fully implements the preferred insurance position, including the conditional cyber/privacy coverage, and therefore also exceeds the fallback limits. It adds only the insurance covenant and an appropriate term-long maintenance period, without altering the existing risk-of-loss or notice terms. Drafting is clear and enforceable, though placement after an apparently incomplete notices provision and the absence of a separate section number reduce structural quality.
